turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I changed the prompts so the recap keeps tasks that have an owner but no deadline. I haven't run it on a real meeting yet, so I can't confirm the model now keeps them.

**What was wrong:** The recap you get when you end a meeting comes from `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`. Its prompt said nothing about tasks without a deadline. The backup prompt, `GROQ_SUMMARY_JSON_PROMPT` in `electron/llm/prompts.ts`, was worse: its only example was "Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday", which taught the model that a task needs a due date. The other prompts in the app already say to keep these tasks; these two never got that rule.

**What I changed:**
- **The main recap prompt:** it now says to keep every task that has an owner and mark undated ones "(no date given)", using your Priya example. That rule also covers custom note templates.
- **The action items description in that prompt:** it now asks for "Owner: task", with the due date if one was given and "(no date given)" if not.
- **The backup prompt:** I added the same rule, plus a second example, "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)".

**Not checked:** I only changed prompt text. The type-check didn't run because the compiler isn't installed locally and the sandbox blocked the download. To test it, record a short meeting where someone says "Priya will send the contract" with no date, end it, and the recap should show "Priya: Send the contract (no date given)".

One separate bug I noticed and didn't fix: when the backup prompt is used, the model returns its overview under the key `"summary"`, but the code reads `overview`. So the overview line is probably blank on those meetings. I can fix that too if you want.

I found three more places where these tasks get lost. I've fixed them, but nothing here can be tested yet: there's no `node_modules` in this repo, so I couldn't build or type-check, and I haven't run a meeting through it.

**1. Long meetings were cut off before the end.** The recap only sent the first 10,000 characters of the transcript to the model, which is roughly the first 15 minutes. Tasks usually get handed out in the wrap-up, so "Priya will send the contract" at minute 40 was never seen. It now sends the first 2,500 and last 7,500 characters, with a marker where the middle was skipped (`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`).

**2. Several modes only kept your own tasks.** If a mode is active (Team meeting, Sales, Recruiting and so on), the Action Items section was described as "action items that **I** would do". Priya's task isn't yours, so the model left it out. Two changes:
- The recap prompt now says follow-up and action-item sections include tasks for anyone, with or without a date. This overrides the narrower wording, so it also covers sections you've customized.
- I rewrote the General and Team meeting template wording in `electron/services/ModesManager.ts`. Copies of those sections already saved to the database keep the old wording, but the new prompt rule covers them.

**3. Very long meetings lost tasks a second time.** Once a meeting gets long, the app condenses its earliest part into 3 to 5 bullets of topics, decisions and questions, with no mention of tasks. Anything assigned early disappeared there. That condensing step now also has to list every task with its owner (`electron/SessionTracker.ts`).

If it still misses tasks after this, tell me which mode you had on and roughly how long the meeting was. That would point to which of these was the cause.

You've been testing an old build. The app you open is `/Applications/Natively.app`, built May 10, and none of my changes are in it. I searched its bundle: the new prompt text appears 0 times, and the old line that cut the transcript at 10,000 characters is still there. The edits are only in the source code in this folder, which has never been built. There's no `node_modules` and no compiled output here.

So both of your tests ran the original code. That doesn't prove my fixes work, only that they haven't been tried yet.

I can't build it from here because the sandbox blocks the npm package registry. In this folder, run:

```
npm install
npm start
```

That opens a development copy of the app with the fixes. Record a short meeting where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" with no date, end it, and check the action items. If that works and you want the app in `/Applications` updated too, run `npm run dist`. It builds a new installer under `release/`, and you install that over the old app.

If the undated task is still missing in the development copy, send me the terminal output from `npm start` after you end the meeting. The line `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response` shows exactly what the model returned, so I can tell whether the model dropped the task or the code did.

I also saved a note for future sessions that you run the installed app, so I'll check whether a build actually contains a change before calling it fixed.
